# format-text

padded score + MM:SS timer readouts

Category: text

## Run it

```sh
cd format-text && bb run   # from this demo (or jolt run, jolt -M:run)
bb format-text             # from the repo root (or jolt -M:format-text)
```

## About

raylib [text] example - formatted text (`joltc -M:format-text`).

A zero-padded score and an MM:SS timer counting up, built with
clojure.core/format and drawn each frame.
